name: Uberaba

queries.query: Uberaba Brazil official cadastral parcel map parcel API municipality GIS property cadastre
queries.result: First-party results identified Uberaba municipal IPTU/property-cadastre services, the municipal portal, an official municipal records schedule describing cadastral plans, and IBGE's municipal map download. No public Uberaba parcel ID-plus-geometry viewer or API was exposed.

queries.query: Uberaba mapa cadastral oficial prefeitura cadastro imobiliário geoprocessamento parcela lote
queries.result: First-party Portuguese results identified the Prefeitura's Consulta Unidades no Terreno and FAQ, official records describing cadastro imobiliário and plantas cadastrais, the municipal plan-director requirement for a georeferenced cadastral register, and a municipal georeferencing/CTM project. No anonymous parcel geometry endpoint or current public map configuration was exposed.

freshResearch.method: Separate first-party English and Brazilian-Portuguese discovery followed by bounded TLS-verified GETs and static HTML/configuration inspection; no credentials, private tokens, login, CAPTCHA/Cloudflare bypass, unsafe lookup or TLS disablement.

portalsFound.observation: Official municipal IPTU service exposes a Consulta Unidades no Terreno form requiring quadrante/setor/lote/unidade identifiers. It is an identifier-based property lookup, not an anonymous parcel geometry service; no form was submitted because the response could expose unsafe property data and no safe geometry route was documented.

Official municipal FAQ states that Identificação Cadastral is the property's municipal cadastral number and identifies the Secretaria Municipal da Fazenda / Departamento de Cadastro Imobiliário as the custodian. It establishes local custody, not public vector access.
Official municipal records schedule lists cadastro imobiliário, cadastral plans, block plans and subdivision plans as municipal records. This is local cadastral-record evidence, not a parcel API.
IBGE national agency download directory exposes a 2020 municipal map PDF for Uberaba. It is general cartography and not evidence of parcel-level geometry or local registry custody.

requests.assessment: TLS-verified GET returned the public identifier-based property lookup form. Static inspection found no map, WMS, WFS, ArcGIS, GeoServer or parcel-geometry endpoint.
TLS-verified GET returned municipal cadastral-custody and identifier documentation; no geometry service route was exposed.
TLS-verified GET returned the municipal portal; static inspection found no parcel viewer or public parcel API route.
TLS-verified GET returned the official IBGE download directory and a municipal-map PDF listing; no parcel vector service was present.

coverageAssessment.claimedScope: Uberaba municipality, Minas Gerais, under the Prefeitura Municipal / Secretaria Municipal da Fazenda / Departamento de Cadastro Imobiliário cadastral system.
coverageAssessment.verifiedOpenScope: Municipal cadastral custody and identifier-based inquiry evidence only; anonymous parcel geometry, source schema, CRS and citywide open coverage were not verified.

remainingUncertainty: The current municipal GIS viewer/API route, access controls, parcel schema, CRS, stable native parcel identity, update currency and citywide coverage remain unresolved. The exact WUP point was preserved and never shifted; no exact-point hit or miss inference was made. No claim is made about parcel absence, legal title, ownership, tax records or completeness of any Brazilian cadastral dataset.
nextStep: A later attempt may inspect an officially exposed Uberaba geospatial viewer or service configuration and test only a bounded anonymous ID-plus-geometry query.
